# rlsbl unreleased

List the commits of the releasable the working directory selects since the nearest release this checkout contains, newest first, each marked COVERED when an unreleased changelog entry names it, EXEMPT when it needs no entry (it carries the Autogenerated: true trailer, or changes only rlsbl's own records), and MISSING otherwise, with the coverage count. Only commits changing a file of the releasable's members or its own records are listed, and in a fork the upstream's history is left out. The releasable's latest release is named when this checkout does not contain it. A member versioned under no releasable has no changelog and is refused.

**Effect:** read_only
